items.title: Citi cuts Abercrombie rating after stock surge, lifts price target
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi cut its rating for Abercrombie & Fitch (NYSE: ANF) to Neutral from Buy on Thursday, saying the retailer's sharp post-earnings rally has left the risk/reward more balanced despite a strong quarter.

items.title: Citi sees an opportunity in Oracle after ’one of the most extreme’ stock drawdowns
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi opened a positive catalyst watch on Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) on Wednesday, telling investors that the software group's recent collapse has created an entry point ahead of results and its investor day in late October.
